description: Header file defining spinlock wait operations, including structures and functions for atomic transitions, waiting, waking, and delaying on spinlocks within the Abseil library.

classes.name: SpinLockWaitTransition
classes.description: Structure representing a transition from one state to another in spinlock wait operations.

methods.name: SpinLockWait
methods.description: Performs waiting until a transition from 'from' to 'to' is possible on an atomic uint32_t, returning the old value.

methods.name: SpinLockWake
methods.description: Wakes one or all threads waiting on a spinlock, if possible.

methods.name: SpinLockDelay
methods.description: Implements delay strategies in spinlock loops, such as yielding or sleeping.

methods.name: SpinLockSuggestedDelayNS
methods.description: Provides a suggested delay in nanoseconds for a given spin loop iteration.
